description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class for the EmployeeCSVImportAPI in the OrangeHRM software project. It tests various API endpoints related to employee CSV data import, including create, delete, validation rules, and fetching all records. The class extends EndpointTestCase and uses mock objects to verify behavior and integration points.

classes.name: EmployeeCSVImportAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeCSVImportAPI endpoints such as create, delete, get validation rules, and get all. It verifies the API behavior with mocked dependencies and ensures proper response and validation logic.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete method is not implemented and expects an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that the getValidationRuleForDelete method is not implemented and expects an exception.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests that the getAll method is not implemented and expects an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests that the getValidationRuleForGetAll method is not implemented and expects an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the validation rules returned by getValidationRuleForCreate, particularly for the attachment parameter, using mocked ConfigService to set max attachment size.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the create method of EmployeeCSVImportAPI, mocking the PimCsvDataImportService to simulate CSV import and verify the returned metadata about success, failure, and failed rows.
